This simple '''cabbage salad''' goes wonderfully with [[Cookbook:Pizza|pizza]].

== Ingredients ==
* ½ head (500 [[Cookbook:Gram|grams]])  [[Cookbook:Cabbage|white cabbage]]
* 100 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] [[Cookbook:Rapeseed Oil|rapeseed oil]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] [[Cookbook:Vinegar|white vinegar]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of [[Cookbook:salt|salt]]
* 1 pinch of coarsely-ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]

== Procedure ==
#Slice the cabbage finely (about 1–2 mm thick).
#Make a dressing of oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper. [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|Toss]] the cabbage with the dressing.
#Put the salad in the fridge overnight.
